text:
Situation: Aspirin and extended-release dipyridamole 25 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 472 capsules (27.3 days at 17.3/day). Corvale General holds 720 capsules across two lots (17.9 and 19.5 days at 38.6/day combined). Corvale Lakeside holds 49 capsules (13.4 days at 3.7/day). Total system supply is approximately 1,241 capsules.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include this product as of 2026-10-21. FDA status shows "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Current inventory covers 13 to 27 days per site. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple manufacturers remain available and are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as primary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify AvKARE as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Inc. as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor Micro Labs Limited and NorthStar Rx LLC for future allocation; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to report weekly inventory days-on-hand to P&T Committee until all sites exceed 30 days supply; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
